about_the_game:
SECOND SHIFT is a first-person horror game that immerses players in a deep and intense atmosphere. Using a mysterious clock, uncover terrifying secrets while trying to escape the mine. Solve puzzles, pay attention to details, and most importantly—survive.

STORY

Adam Harper is trapped in a mine filled with terrifying secrets and a mysterious clock. To survive and find his lost friend, Owen Miller, he must navigate a dark and perilous journey. As Adam progresses with the clock’s help, he uncovers the sinister truths of both the mine and his own past.

GAMEPLAY

Use your clock to access unseen realities and protect yourself from lurking dangers.

Break rocks with your pickaxe to dig deeper into the mine. Every strike opens new paths, unravels mysteries, and brings you closer to survival.

Face horrifying creatures lurking in the dark depths of the mine. Prepare for the peak of fear!

content_descriptors.notes: Our game contains significant amounts of blood and gore. It also explores a psychological disorder, providing a deep and immersive experience that delves into complex mental health themes. Players will encounter strong language and profanity throughout the game. The game features intense violence, including dismembered body parts, but there are no sexual content or themes. This mature content is integral to the game's narrative and atmosphere, and we aim to deliver a thought-provoking and intense experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
